LeSean McCoy, 26, heads to Buffalo after six season in Philadelphia .

He claims the Bundesliga forces harder training and greater pressure, making matches more intense than the Premier League.  
While English clubs struggle in Europe, German teams such as Bayern Munich and Dortmund stay strong contenders.

Harry Kane has scored 29 goals in all competitions for Tottenham .
Rodney Marsh believes Kane, 21, is worth a £100million transfer fee .
Marsh backs him to go on and become better than Alan Shearer .

Arsenal captain Mikel Arteta is taking coaching badges .

Her son Tim feels the paperwork is a means‑test, saying they are being forced to “grovel for a pittance.”

summary: Roy Hodgson will travel to St. Petersburg for the 2018 World Cup qualifying draw. He has told the FA he wants to remain England manager for another two years and pursue a second World Cup. His attendance may fuel speculation, though it’s common for outgoing coaches to attend official events.
reference:

Hodgson wants second crack at taking England to World Cup finals .

summary: A 10‑year‑old boy at Grant School in Dumont, New Jersey, died after jumping from a second‑story window following a chess dispute. He fell about 25 feet to concrete and was taken to Hackensack University Medical Center, where he died around 5 p.m. The boy’s name has not been released and a teacher’s aide and other students were in the room when the jump occurred.
reference:
Boy landed on concrete outside Grant School in Dumont, New Jersey .
Fifth-grade student jumped yesterday around noon and fell 25 feet .

summary: George Osborne will eliminate tax on the first £1,000 of interest earned from savings. This change will benefit 17 million savers, most with up to £35 000 in deposits. As a result, 95 % of savers will no longer pay tax on their savings interest.
reference:
No tax on the first £1,000 of interest savers earn from their nest eggs .

summary: 18‑year‑old Hannah Tate, battling rare kidney cancer, was able to attend her senior prom after a celebrity hairstylist, Tokyo Stylez, gifted her a custom wig and makeover. summary: IKEA banned a popular “hide and seek” event that drew more than 33,000 sign‑ups at its Tempe, Sydney store. Participants planned to hide in wardrobes and under soft toys, beginning at 1 pm. The retailer said the game posed security risks for both customers and staff, so it was stopped.
reference:
Furniture giant IKEA has banned people from playing hide and seek .

Authorities failed to protect them and have not increased security for other bloggers, raising concerns over freedom of expression. Amnesty International condemns the government's inaction and calls for stronger safeguards for those at risk.
reference:
The 27-year-old Rahman falls victim to the same brazen act that killed Avijit Roy .

summary: Chris Borland retired from the NFL at 24, citing concerns about long‑term brain damage after a minor concussion in training camp. He chose to prioritize his health over a multi‑million‑dollar contract with the San Francisco 49ers. Though teammates and friends questioned the decision, Borland emphasized that his priority was well‑being, not money.

Chris Borland tells ESPN that "I know this is right for me"

Her son, Logan, was born two months ago after a 30‑minute resuscitation but is now healthy and thriving.  
Despite online backlash calling her an unfit mother, Bianca remains determined to find his father, a fly‑in, fly‑out worker she met at a nightclub.

summary: A 175‑lb female bear was stuck in a tree in Tracy, California for over two hours, prompting wildlife officials to tranquilize her with four darts. After the darts took effect, she fell safely into a tarp set up below. The incident drew a large crowd of onlookers who watched as the bear was released back into the wild.
reference:
Onlookers gasped as the 175-pound bear fell several feet after California Fish and Wildlife officers shot the female with four tranquilizer darts .

She and another student have are suspended from Sunnycrest Elementary .

summary: Fernando Alonso praised McLaren’s progress as “fantastic” despite qualifying 18th. summary: New research proposes that Stonehenge’s stones were pillars for a raised wooden platform, not for ground‑level rituals. Historian Julian Spalding argues this platform served as a high altar for ceremonies, inspired by similar structures worldwide. The theory suggests we have misinterpreted the monument by focusing on its ground‑level layout.

But the wood has long since rotted away, leaving only the stones behind .

summary: Scientists in California injected a volunteer's eyes with a Ce6‑insulin saline solution, giving him the ability to see over 50 m in near total darkness for several hours. The biohacker group reported that treated eyes could spot moving targets in darkness 100% of the time, while untreated eyes succeeded only a third of the time. Separately, researchers at the University of Michigan have created an ultra‑thin graphene infrared sensor that could be incorporated into future night‑vision contact lenses.
reference:
Solution uses Chlorin e6 (Ce6) insulin and saline to enable night vision .
A test subject was able to see in darkness 'for several hours'
Ability wore off the following day, with 'no noticeable effects' after 20 days .

summary: Teacher Keith Allison sued his Ohio school, claiming he was fired because of Facebook posts opposed to dairy farming. After offering food, the firefighters successfully brought Jake back to safety.

Scientists using X‑ray beams at ALS found a “secret” volcanic ash‑lime mortar ingredient that explains the durability of Roman concrete.
reference:
Emperor Augustus boasted about how his rule left Rome 'a city of marble' while historical accounts said it glittered .
Historians at the University of California Los Angeles have reconstructed ancient Rome using architectural software .
They found that most of the buildings were built mainly from brick and only a few temples were made from marble .
Those that were made from marble would have been difficult to see from many parts of the city, say the researchers .

summary: Barcelona’s forward line of Suarez, Neymar and Messi will face Real Madrid’s trio of Ronaldo, Bale and Benzema at Camp Nou. reference:

summary: A seven‑year study found pescetarians—those who eat fish but no red meat—had a 43% lower risk of colorectal cancer. Colorectal cancer is the third most common and third leading cause of cancer death in the US. Early stages of the disease are often symptom‑free, making prevention and early detection especially important.
reference:
A new study shows a 43% lower risk of contracting colorectal cancer with a pesco-vegetarian diet .

Plant-based diets may also contribute to greater weight loss and lower blood pressure .

summary:
A new University of Zurich study finds playfulness ranks highly among qualities sought in long‑term partners, just behind friendliness, intelligence, and humor.  
Researchers say a sense of fun is often valued more than formal education or religiousness.  
Playful adults—spontaneous, witty, and lighthearted—tend to prioritize humor, a relaxed attitude, and creativity in potential partners.
reference:
University of Zurich study revealed importance of playfulness in a partner .
Trait ranked just below friendliness, intelligence and a sense of humour .

summary: A 40‑year‑old murder mystery takes a dramatic turn as the victim’s husband allegedly confesses to the triple killing on his deathbed in 2011. Queensland Police are investigating Bill McCulkin’s claim that he murdered his wife, Barbara, and their two daughters in 1974. The family vanished from their Brisbane home in January 1974 and has never been seen again.

Victim's husband allegedly confessed to murders on his deathbed .
Bill McCulkin had  been cleared by police  of killing wife and children .

Gary Reginald Dubois and Vincent O'Dempsey charged in last year .

summary: Motorcyclist sustained a pierced scrotum and broken thigh bone after a crash. He was taken to Ulm University Hospital with a swollen, bluish scrotum and an externally rotated left leg. A CT scan revealed the femur had been sheared off, confirming severe injuries.
reference:
33-year-old admitted to hospital in Germany with 'hard, swollen scrotum'

Police tracked him to a house in Mount Pleasant following fresh snow footprints. He was found hiding in the bushes, and the standoff ended when he killed himself.
reference:
Man, 20, abducted woman from Lakeview Specialty Hospital and Rehab near Rochester, Wisconsin, about 3pm Sunday .

summary: A California company is developing a $5,000 laser procedure that permanently turns any eye color to blue. The method uses low‑energy lasers and scavenger cells to digest iris pigment, triggering the body to remove the pigment and reveal a natural blue iris. Clinical trials are ongoing to validate safety and efficacy.

summary: More than 60 Iraqi cultural artifacts smuggled into the U.S. were returned to the Iraqi government at a Washington, D.C. ceremony. summary: The 2008 Los Angeles fast‑food ordinance that barred new standalone outlets in South Los Angeles had little effect on the area’s food environment. Because the ban exempted strip malls and convenience stores, the region continued to see an influx of new fast‑food and junk‑food options there. A RAND study found that nearly half of the new permits went to convenience stores, with 17 new chain restaurants opening in strip centers between 2008 and 2012.
reference:
